notes.title: UPDATE 2
notes.notes:
Thank you all for continuing to play Doll Inc! A few days ago, several bugs were reported to me that I couldn’t fix at the time because I was working on this update. This should fix all of them. Please use the official channels like Discord to report any issues.

[list]
[*] Feature: Auto-reason upgrade
[*] Feature: New Extra Only dispatches (You can select: Robots, cases, dolls)
[*] Feature: New Extra Only returns
[*] Feature: New Extra Only orders (You can select: Robots, cases, dolls, storage machines and case name)
[*] Feature: Halloween event added
[*] Feature: Christmas event added
[*] Feature: Doll Impostor Screamers added on dispatches and Storage
[*] Feature: Added a button to enable/disable Jumpscares (On Exit door)
[*] Fixed: Can pick the doll before the system
[*] Fixed: When load a game it not works (It's like worker but bugged)
[/list]

[b]That said, if you enjoy Doll Inc, please leave us a positive review! It really helps us continue developing the game![/b]

notes.title: Launch delay
notes.notes:
[b]📢 Release Update – Doll Inc. Launch Moved to July 21st[/b]

Hello everyone,

We wanted to inform you that [b]Doll Inc.[/b] will now be launching on [b]July 21st[/b] instead of today.

After reviewing the timing, we realized that today coincides with Steam’s [i]Automation Fest[/i], an event that could significantly reduce visibility for new releases not officially featured. To give [b]Doll Inc.[/b] the launch it truly deserves, we’ve decided to postpone the release until the event concludes.

[b]Please note:[/b] The store page will temporarily show the game as [i]Coming Soon[/i], but the release is fully set for [b]July 21st[/b]. No changes will be made to the build or content — this is purely a strategic timing adjustment.

We believe this will ensure a better experience for everyone — both for new players discovering the game and for the community that’s been following its development.

[b]Thank you so much for your patience and support.[/b]  
We’re incredibly grateful to have you with us on this journey!
